title: MC Sprint v0.1 — Regression Fixture
description: Per-sprint fixture record under paths.sprintRegressionCorpus/<SP-id>/<RF-id>.yaml. Introduced 2026-05-18 by SP-20260518-007. Captures the executable contract that the sprint's originally-reported failure is closed and would still be detected if it regressed.

id.description: Sprint-scoped fixture id following the project's other sprint ids (SP/PC/T/I/ESD/AP/RL).

origin.description: Pointer to what surfaced the failure this fixture closes.

ref.description: Free-text reference. For bug_id: I-id; for ticket_id: T-id; for user_report: ts + short summary; for internal_observation: source + ts.

bug_classes_closed.description: Named bug classes the fixture claims to close. Match plan_contract.goal_verification.bug_classes_closed.

cited_tests.description: One or more cited tests. The release ship-gate runs each.

fixture_path.description: Self-reference: the path to this YAML record under paths.sprintRegressionCorpus/<sprint_id>/. Useful when the record is loaded out of context.
